decisions.name: IREN Childress Horizons 1-4
decisions.reason: Horizon 1 is completed/accepted on August 13. Horizons 2-4 must not inherit its certification or be counted as independent physical campuses. The August 27 issuer update describes commissioning and late construction, but its current business update is after the August 20 cutoff, not automatically a June 30 observation. Earlier May 7 evidence is stale.

decisions.name: Google Bermuda Hundred / Peanut LLC
decisions.reason: The county July table is actual construction evidence, not mere zoning. It has month precision only. The baseline San Bovio source uses an explicit conservative month-start convention; this packet does not silently invent July 20 or July 23 from PDF creation or unrelated article publication. Exact project-bound reusable locator and authority/rights review remain required. Three buildings are one campus; Upper Magnolia Green and Watkins Centre are separate future projects.

decisions.name: Chirisa Digital Drive DDC campus

No operating power, actual water demand, coordinate or separate building count is normalized.
